meta.desc: 内页信息的骨架。底层 117 种布局归纳为 15 组。prompt 为排版指令，可与风格层叠加。

items.desc: 一句话占满画面，极致冲击
items.prompt: big-title layout, one short phrase fills the frame, maximum visual impact, centered bold typography

items.desc: 枚举排名，每项一行，带序号
items.prompt: list layout, enumerated ranking format, one item per line with number markers, clean vertical rhythm
card grid layout, multiple modular cards in a grid, clear information zones, balanced spacing

items.desc: 左右/上下 50% 分屏，细线分隔
items.prompt: binary comparison layout, split 50/50 left-right or top-bottom, thin divider line, two columns of parallel info

items.desc: 线性步骤 3–6 步，箭头串联
items.prompt: flow timeline layout, linear 3 to 6 steps connected by arrows, numbered sequence, clear progression
mind map layout, central node radiating 4 to 8 branches, organic connections, hierarchical clarity
quadrant layout, four zones in a square or circle, each zone a distinct dimension, clear labels

items.desc: 主体+零件引导线，表现组成
items.prompt: exploded diagram layout, main object with parts separated around it, leader lines labeling each component
cross-section layout, object cut open to show internal spaces and functional zones, readable interior

items.desc: 一幅连贯场景藏信息节点
items.prompt: continuous scene layout, one coherent scene where information nodes hide in roads, figures, props; not a grid

items.desc: 多角色自由站位+短标签
items.prompt: character group layout, multiple figures freely positioned with short labels, clear spacing and balance
hub and spoke layout, one large central visual with smaller units around it, each labeled, knowledge web

items.desc: 顶部标本+中部模块+底部来源
items.prompt: encyclopedia card layout, top specimen display, middle asymmetric info modules, bottom source area, three-section

items.desc: 多对象按真实大小排列
items.prompt: scale comparison layout, multiple objects arranged by real or relative size, baseline and arrows show progression

items.desc: 高信息密度知识卡 5–8 点
items.prompt: dense modules layout, high information density knowledge card, 5 to 8 points, compact but readable
